destination.title: Moduli stabilization, vacuum control and physical consequences
destination.question: Under which source-specific assumptions can string/M-theory compactifications and related supergravity models stabilize the required fields, support candidate nonnegative-energy vacua, and retain reliable effective descriptions and physical applications?
destination.summary: A proposed organizing family spanning construction mechanisms, precursor vacua, geometric and effective-theory checks, survival and applications. Shared membership does not identify mechanisms, field content, dimensional settings or scoped questions.

systems: Source-specified string/M-theory compactifications and related supergravity models
KKLT, LVS and other stabilization frameworks where identified
Antibrane sectors, dynamical supersymmetry-breaking sectors and proposed alternatives
targets: Moduli stabilization and candidate Minkowski or de Sitter vacua
Geometric admissibility, retained field content and perturbative stability
Correction control, embedding, charge budgets and effective descriptions
Vacuum survival, cosmology, mediation and other source-specific physical consequences
regimes: Direct stabilization and sequential uplift as distinct alternatives
Hierarchical large volume, Kähler uplifting and source-specific warped regimes
Separate zero-temperature, thermal and rolling-cosmology questions
Different dimensions and field truncations retained as specified by each source
assumptions: Construction, hierarchy and control assumptions are local to each source
An uplift ingredient, a stabilized endpoint and a globally controlled compactification require separate checks
Proposed conjectures and contested obstruction arguments are conditional objects of comparison
Child ledgers provide attributed descendant coverage; this review reads only the supplied contrasts
conventions: Metastable minima, unstable saddles and rolling solutions remain distinct
Perturbative stability and decay lifetime are separate targets
Geometric lifting and vacuum-energy uplifting are not identified
Source dates, normalization choices and original reading limits remain attached to reused records
includes: AdS precursor geometry and negative or incomplete construction results
Cross-batch target, method and application routes
Alternate homes for neighboring questions outside vacuum stabilization
excludes: A universal existence or exclusion claim for controlled de Sitter vacua
Treating numerical ancestry as mandatory scientific parentage
Treating the Taub–NUT charge or fixed-volume K3 comparison as an uplift construction
Promotion of child questions or replacements still requiring adjudication

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Which intersection structures admit the ordinary LVS hierarchy without forcing another physical cycle below the string scale?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization and uplifting with dynamically generated F-terms

evidence.text: Can dynamical F-term supersymmetry breaking uplift a KKLT vacuum to zero energy while retaining a TeV gravitino, stabilized moduli and a long lifetime, and what visible-sector soft terms follow?

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Are omitted bulk and localized terms suppressed in hierarchical LVS, and can BPS charge–tension matching forbid candidate induced potentials?

sources.title: Lifetime of Stringy de Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: How long does an uplifted string/M-theory de Sitter vacuum survive against tunneling toward infinite-volume decompactification when no additional local minimum remains after uplift?

sources.title: Evidence for a bound on the lifetime of de Sitter space

evidence.text: Do antibrane-uplifted KKLT de Sitter vacua satisfy a Boltzmann-Brain-motivated upper lifetime bound, despite the ability to make supersymmetry breaking exponentially small, and how controlled is the construction?

sources.title: Axionic D3-D7 Inflation

evidence.text: Does the effective four-dimensional supergravity of stabilized K3 × T²/Z₂ compactifications admit slow-roll D3 motion, and how do bulk-modulus dynamics and the choice of uplifting affect its existence, tuning, and predictions?

sources.title: F-term Uplift in Heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Can vector bundle moduli provide sufficient F-term uplift to stabilize supersymmetry-breaking Minkowski or de Sitter vacua in heterotic M-theory, including when the tree-level superpotential is constant?

sources.title: A sufficient condition for de Sitter vacua in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: Can Kähler uplifting yield an analytic sufficient condition, expressed through flux and compactification data, for metastable de Sitter vacua with small positive vacuum energy, spontaneously broken supersymmetry and stabilized moduli?

sources.title: De Sitter Vacua from Nonperturbative Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Can a moduli-dependent nonperturbative superpotential stabilize the modeled type IIB moduli simultaneously in a metastable de Sitter vacuum, without a separate explicitly supersymmetry-breaking uplift?

sources.title: De Sitter Vacua from a D-term Generated Racetrack Uplift

evidence.text: Can a D-term relation between two small Kähler moduli generate an F-term racetrack uplift from an LVS AdS minimum to metastable de Sitter, while keeping the D-term potential zero and avoiding additional warping or dilaton suppression?

sources.title: Single-step de Sitter vacua from nonperturbative effects with matter

evidence.text: Can coupled closed-string moduli and matter fields produce single-step metastable de Sitter stabilization through a pure F-term potential, without assuming that the axiodilaton and complex structure were already stabilized at a higher scale?

sources.title: De Sitter from T-branes

evidence.text: Can hidden-sector F-term uplifting induced by D-term stabilization be understood by expanding a higher-dimensional D7 theory around a supersymmetric T-brane background, and can the resulting contribution support de Sitter LVS minima?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua from an anomalous gauge symmetry

evidence.text: Can magnetic-flux and anomaly-induced FI terms, a moduli-dependent gauge kinetic function and a gauge-invariant nonperturbative superpotential stabilize moduli in metastable de Sitter or Minkowski vacua without additional low-energy uplift fields?

sources.title: A New Class of de Sitter Vacua in Type IIB Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Can the Large Volume Scenario support perturbatively metastable de Sitter vacua through small flux-induced supersymmetry breaking in the complex-structure/axio-dilaton sector, without an additional uplift sector?

sources.title: Racing through the swampland: de Sitter uplift vs weak gravity

evidence.text: Can a racetrack potential stabilize a type-IIB volume modulus strongly enough for controlled de Sitter uplift while its axionic partner satisfies a strong Weak Gravity Conjecture? The proposed connection concerns this stabilization mechanism and depends on the strength assigned to the conjecture.

sources.title: Uplifting Anti-D6-brane

evidence.text: Can a type IIA STU effective model stabilize all moduli in a supersymmetric AdS minimum using only six-form flux and nonperturbative terms, then admit a metastable de Sitter uplift from anti-D6-branes?

sources.title: Inflation, gravity mediated supersymmetry breaking, and de Sitter vacua in supergravity with a Kähler-invariant Fayet-Iliopoulos term

evidence.text: Can supergravity with the KKLT Kähler potential and superpotential, without anti-D3 branes, support inflation, supersymmetry breaking and a post-inflationary de Sitter vacuum while remaining applicable above the supersymmetry-breaking scale?

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: Can microscopic vacua vary their cosmological constant independently of the gravitino mass, and would one or two towers govern those limits? The paper leaves this question open.

sources.title: A new de Sitter solution with a weakly warped deformed conifold

evidence.text: Can subdominant warping in the conifold-modulus Kähler metric support a new metastable de Sitter vacuum when the conifold deformation and bulk volume are stabilised together, and how well controlled is that vacuum?

sources.title: A new de Sitter solution with a weakly warped deformed conifold

evidence.text: Can a weakly warped conifold in LVS support a metastable de Sitter vacuum with stabilized moduli and the stated effective-theory controls?

sources.title: LVS de Sitter vacua are probably in the swampland

evidence.text: Do general LVS correction sensitivities and the control obstruction in one explicit model prevent controlled dS vacua throughout the LVS class?

sources.title: LVS de Sitter vacua are probably in the swampland

evidence.text: Can an LVS compactification with two Kähler moduli, a conifold modulus and anti-brane uplift admit dS vacua whose unknown corrections are parametrically negligible?

sources.title: Topological constraints in the LARGE-volume scenario

evidence.text: How do topology and orientifold/brane data constrain simultaneous suppression of corrections in LVS de Sitter vacua, and is a large D3 tadpole alone sufficient?

sources.title: The Octagon at large M

evidence.text: Could a throat with dynamical supersymmetry breaking replace an explicit anti-D-brane ingredient in a compact de Sitter construction, possibly combining moduli stabilization and supersymmetry breaking in one construction?

sources.title: Joint statistics of cosmological constant and SUSY breaking in flux vacua with nilpotent Goldstino

evidence.text: How are the gravitino mass and cosmological constant jointly distributed in KKLT and LVS flux vacua when both moduli stabilization and warped anti-D3 uplift are incorporated, sampling only stabilized vacua?

sources.title: Heterotic de Sitter beyond modular symmetry

evidence.text: Which branches of two-modulus heterotic orbifold effective theories forbid metastable de Sitter vacua, and can inherently stringy corrections of strength O(exp(-1/gs)) evade those restrictions while preserving T-duality?

sources.title: De Sitter vacua — when are ‘subleading corrections’ really subleading?

evidence.text: Can candidate weakly warped LVS de Sitter vacua remain consistent after expected string-loop, curvature and warping corrections are included, considering their effects on moduli vevs and vacuum energy as well as the off-shell potential?

sources.title: Kaluza–Klein tower and bubble nucleation in six dimensional Einstein–Maxwell theory

evidence.text: How do flux and uplift control KK masses, curvature-scale separation, and Minkowski limits, and does KK-tower descent obstruct flux-bubble transitions to ‘nothing’ or constrain metastable de Sitter vacua through the distance and cobordism conjectures?

sources.title: Thermal effects and finite-temperature cosmology in perturbatively stabilized large volume scenarios

evidence.text: How do finite-temperature effects reshape perturbatively stabilized large-volume vacua, set decompactification and reheating bounds, and affect modulus domination and the eventual recovery or decay of the zero-temperature vacuum?

sources.title: Control Problem of de Sitter Vacua with T-brane Uplift

evidence.text: Can T-brane uplifting produce self-consistent LVS de Sitter vacua with suppressed string and backreaction corrections, once uplift normalization, topology, tadpoles and brane-moduli stabilization are included?

sources.title: Jumping Through Loops: On Soft Terms from Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: The proposed diagnostic compares a candidate DBI-induced tension with a corresponding Chern–Simons charge term under BPS assumptions. Applying it to the listed flux–curvature terms remains heuristic.

sources.title: Lifetime of Stringy de Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: Preserve the axion isometry during stabilization, gauge it with magnetic D7 flux, and use the positive D-term for uplift. The isometry is an input condition, so the construction cannot be transferred unchanged to a shift-breaking superpotential.

sources.title: Evidence for a bound on the lifetime of de Sitter space

evidence.text: Use thin-wall Coleman–De Luccia Euclidean instantons, with rate per four-volume proportional to exp(−B), B the instanton-background action difference. The field-theory action is B₀ = 27π²τ⁴/[2(δV)³]; gravitational effects are organized by x = τ²/τ_c².

sources.title: Axionic D3-D7 Inflation

evidence.text: Search numerically using the full supergravity F- and D-term potentials. The axionic example evolves all six real fields under the slow-roll approximation; the near-D7 search evaluates an effective potential at instantaneous S and T minima.

sources.title: F-term Uplift in Heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Split the F-term potential into V0 and positive bundle-dependent square terms δV0. Uplift requires kα^I∂IW+∂αW≠0 for at least one bundle modulus α, and therefore entails supersymmetry breaking.

sources.title: A sufficient condition for de Sitter vacua in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: Expanding in ξ̂/V̂ and Ae^(−at)/|W0| reduces the single-modulus potential to a negative exponential term plus a positive inverse-power term. The allowed window is bounded by simultaneous V=V′=0 at its lower edge and V′=V″=0 at its upper edge.

sources.title: α′ corrections to KPV: an uplifting story

evidence.text: How do known curvature, gauge-field, and flux corrections modify KPV metastability, and can they supply a small positive uplift without a deep warped throat? What control and D3-tadpole requirements follow?

sources.title: Bare-bones de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Can anti-D3 branes supply both the uplift and the small superpotential needed for Kähler-modulus stabilization, allowing de Sitter minima without an independently introduced supersymmetry-breaking flux superpotential?

sources.title: de Sitter string vacua from Kahler uplifting

evidence.text: Can the leading perturbative α′ correction and a nonperturbative superpotential stabilize moduli in metastable de Sitter vacua at large volume and weak coupling, using spontaneous F-term supersymmetry breaking without an additional uplifting sector?

destination.title: Supersymmetry, vacuum structure and gravitational effective theories
destination.question: How do supersymmetry, its breaking and quantum effects shape effective interactions, scalar potentials, vacuum structure and cosmological dynamics, and which model-specific checks establish stability and effective-theory validity?
destination.summary: A discovery family spanning different systems, dimensions and mechanisms. Construction, formulation, scalar stability, effective-theory control, spectra and cosmological evolution are separate targets. Existing scoped questions provide navigation; numerical review batches retain provenance without becoming redundant public branches.

Goldstino effective theories and constrained-multiplet formulations
Rigid supersymmetric and gauge theories through explicit methodological or alternate routes
targets: Representation and diagnosis of supersymmetry breaking
Local scalar stability and reliable effective descriptions
Low-energy interactions, masses and soft terms
Inflation, dark-energy sectors and cosmological phase dynamics
Quantum vacuum structure, longevity, thermal selection and conditional consistency tests

Classical, quantum and finite-temperature questions retain their source-specific regimes
Stationary configurations, evolving backgrounds and Euclidean saddles remain distinct
Effective-supergravity results and controlled higher-dimensional realizations require separate assessments

sources.title: N=2 supergravity models with stable de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Which gauged N=2 supergravity models admit stable de Sitter vacua, and how do noncompact gauging, Fayet–Iliopoulos terms and relative symplectic rotations enable positive-potential critical points without tachyonic physical scalars?

sources.title: De Sitter vacua from matter superpotentials

evidence.text: Can hidden-matter superpotential interactions generate local de Sitter or Minkowski vacua with spontaneous supersymmetry breaking, a hierarchically small breaking scale, and useful observable-sector soft terms?

sources.title: No metastable de Sitter vacua in N=2 supergravity with only hypermultiplets

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional N=2 supergravity with only hypermultiplet matter admit locally stable vacua with spontaneously broken supersymmetry, particularly Minkowski or de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: On the Effective Description of Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: When does freezing the dilaton and complex-structure multiplets in two-step Large Volume Scenario stabilization remain a reliable approximately supersymmetric description after adding matter and gauge interactions, despite lacking a mass hierarchy?

sources.title: On non-universal Goldstino couplings to matter

evidence.text: How can constrained superfields retain UV-dependent, non-universal goldstino–matter interactions generated by integrating out finite-mass superpartners, rather than describing only universal couplings?

sources.title: Simple metastable de Sitter vacua in N=2 gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Can minimal N=2 gauged supergravity with one hypermultiplet and one vector multiplet admit metastable de Sitter vacua without constant Fayet–Iliopoulos terms or non-Abelian gauging, and how does the answer depend on V/m_{3/2}²?

sources.title: Perturbative Stability along the Supersymmetric Directions of the Landscape

evidence.text: When can a large supersymmetric spectator sector remain perturbatively stable after coupling to F-term supersymmetry breaking, at approximately Minkowski vacua or during slow-roll inflation, without a large mass hierarchy?

sources.title: Decoupling and de Sitter Vacua in Approximate No-Scale Supergravities

evidence.text: When can small superpotential deformations lift no-scale Minkowski vacua to metastable de Sitter vacua, while keeping the number of stability tunings independent of the number of chiral fields?

sources.title: Universal dS vacua in STU-models

evidence.text: Can polynomial superpotentials with generalized fluxes yield analytically controlled stable de Sitter critical points near supersymmetric or no-scale Minkowski points, and reproduce the local vacuum properties obtained using nonperturbative superpotentials?

sources.title: Single-Superfield Helical-Phase Inflation

evidence.text: Can helical-phase inflation in supergravity be realized with a single chiral superfield, using stabilization of its radial scalar instead of an additional stabilizer superfield, while obtaining positive quadratic, plateau or natural-inflation potentials?

sources.title: A comment on effective field theories of flux vacua

evidence.text: When perturbative dynamics has runaway directions, can nonperturbative effects consistently be included to find low-energy vacua, particularly in supersymmetry-breaking no-scale supergravity and flux compactifications?

sources.title: De Sitter Vacua in No-Scale Supergravity

evidence.text: How can single-field no-scale constructions of constant positive vacuum energy be extended to multiple chiral fields, while controlling imaginary-direction stability and the allowed powers in the superpotential?

sources.title: Runaway potentials and a massive goldstino

evidence.text: Does spontaneous supersymmetry breaking on an evolving runaway scalar background give the true shifting goldstino an effective mass, and how does that mass depend on the potential, its slope scale, and mixing with other fermions? The analysis remains agnostic about de Sitter swampland conjectures.

sources.title: $\alpha$-attractors from supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can a small R-symmetric correction to hyperbolic Kähler geometry produce viable sgoldstino inflation while retaining spontaneous supersymmetry and R-symmetry breaking in a Minkowski or de Sitter vacuum?

sources.title: Weak gravity versus de Sitter

evidence.text: Does the magnetic weak gravity conjecture obstruct controlled de Sitter critical points in four-dimensional gauged N=2 supergravity, and does a singular Lagrangian gravitino mass matrix identify the obstruction?

sources.title: Lifetimes of near eternal false vacua

evidence.text: How can higher-form symmetries protect false vacua with large energy splittings, and how do their lifetimes depend on ultraviolet physics when that protection is explicitly broken?

sources.title: Tachyonic de Sitter Solutions of 10d Type II Supergravities

evidence.text: Do de Sitter stationary points of ten-dimensional type IIB supergravity possess an unstable direction in the four scalars rho, tau, sigma_1 and sigma_2?

sources.title: F-term multi-field inflation in supergravity without stabiliser superfields

evidence.text: Can the stabiliser-free single-chiral-superfield mechanism be extended to several chiral superfields while retaining a positive, sufficiently flat F-term inflationary potential and stabilizing directions orthogonal to the protected real fields?

sources.title: Consequences of supergravity with gauged U(1)-R symmetry

evidence.text: What low-energy effects survive gauging U(1)R in supergravity when a hidden sector breaks R-symmetry at the Planck scale, breaks supersymmetry at an intermediate scale, and has vanishing vacuum D-term?

sources.title: Aspects of spontaneously broken N=1 global supersymmetry in the presence of gauge interactions

evidence.text: How do spontaneous supersymmetry-breaking masses constrain goldstino interactions, low-energy scattering, and tree-level unitarity when gauge interactions are present, including cases where supersymmetry and gauge symmetry break together?

sources.title: Stable de Sitter vacua from N=2 supergravity

evidence.text: Can matter-coupled N=2 supergravity admit de Sitter extrema without tachyons, and could such models extend to higher supersymmetry or string theory?

sources.title: On de Sitter vacua in strongly coupled heterotic string theory

evidence.text: Can nonperturbative effects in heterotic M-theory produce four-dimensional de Sitter vacua with spontaneous F-term supersymmetry breaking while stabilizing the orbifold-length dilaton?

sources.title: Stable de Sitter vacua in N = 2, D = 5 supergravity

evidence.text: Can five-dimensional N=2 gauged supergravity admit stable de Sitter vacua, and which combinations of scalar geometry, charged tensors, R-symmetry gauging and charged hypers permit them?

sources.title: de Sitter string vacua from Kahler uplifting

evidence.text: Can the leading perturbative α′ correction and a nonperturbative superpotential stabilize moduli in metastable de Sitter vacua at large volume and weak coupling, using spontaneous F-term supersymmetry breaking without an additional uplifting sector?

sources.title: Metastable SUSY Breaking and Supergravity at Finite Temperature

evidence.text: How does supergravity change the finite-temperature phase structure of metastable ISS supersymmetry breaking, and does cooling favor evolution toward the metastable vacuum?

sources.title: No metastable de Sitter vacua in N=2 supergravity with only hypermultiplets

evidence.text: Project the properly normalized scalar Hessian onto the three physical sGoldstino directions. Their directional masses and averaged trace provide upper bounds on the smallest eigenvalue of the full scalar mass matrix.

sources.title: On the Effective Description of Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Large-volume and 1/(at) expansions, Gaussian elimination of H fluctuations, and numerical comparisons of full versus frozen models test vacuum values, auxiliary fields and masses. Numerical examples use a minimal dilaton-plus-one-complex-structure toy sector with leading S₀=U₀=1 and W₀=1.

sources.title: On non-universal Goldstino couplings to matter

evidence.text: Solve classical heavy-scalar equations using the zero-momentum Lagrangian, including zero momentum for light fermions. Identify polynomial superfield constraints through Grassmann identities and their component expansions.

sources.title: Simple metastable de Sitter vacua in N=2 gauged supergravity

evidence.text: Describe local special geometry through a covariantly holomorphic symplectic section and its derivative identities. Impose stationarity, then express the canonically normalized scalar Hessian using α, the complex third-derivative parameter β, and the relative breaking angle θ.

sources.title: Perturbative Stability along the Supersymmetric Directions of the Landscape

evidence.text: Takagi factorization of the complex symmetric fermion mass matrix; projection of the scalar Hessian along fermion eigenvectors orthogonal to the sGoldstino; first-order eigenvalue perturbation theory for small mixing between sectors.

sources.title: Decoupling and de Sitter Vacua in Approximate No-Scale Supergravities

evidence.text: Takagi factorisation of the complex symmetric supersymmetric mass tensor Z diagonalises the unperturbed X-sector Hessian. Its rescaled eigenvalues are (λi±|W|)², where λi are nonnegative singular values; large holomorphic Hessian entries therefore need not cause instability.

sources.title: From Minkowski to de Sitter in Multifield No-Scale Models

evidence.text: Which superpotentials yield Minkowski and constant dS/AdS potentials in no-scale supergravity, how do their pairings generalize geometrically to multiple fields, and how can matter and inflation be incorporated?

sources.title: Goldstino superfields in $ \mathcal{N}=2 $ supergravity

evidence.text: How can constrained Goldstino superfields be coupled to off-shell N=2 supergravity and matter to describe spontaneously broken local supersymmetry, including parameter ranges admitting de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: SUSY Breaking in Local String/F-Theory Models

evidence.text: How strongly does bulk LARGE-volume supersymmetry breaking generate gravity and anomaly mediated soft terms on local Standard Model/GUT branes, and what follows for gauge mediation and the cosmological moduli problem?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: Can a warped string compactification support positive four-dimensional curvature with controlled quantum corrections? The paper asks whether external deformations suffice or whether internal geometry and fluxes must also evolve.

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Can a long warped direction coexist with a string-sized internal space and heavy charged strings?

sources.title: Warping and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can warping turn the high energy associated with an antibrane flux dual into a hierarchically small supersymmetry-breaking scale while maintaining a controlled, stabilized compactification?

sources.title: SUSY Breaking at the Tip of Throat and Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: Can infrared brane supersymmetry breaking generate viable ultraviolet visible soft terms when gauge-coupling moduli were first stabilized supersymmetrically by nonperturbative dynamics?

sources.title: SUSY Breaking at the Tip of Throat and Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: How do stabilization and localization determine the relative strengths of modulus and supergravity transmission of supersymmetry breaking, and therefore the visible soft masses?

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: The mobile D3 position provides the inflaton candidate in a warped throat. Warping suppresses the anti-D3 energy, while conifold geometry supplies calculable radial and angular dependence for forces induced by moduli stabilization.

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can non-geometric fluxes generate an exponentially small gravitino mass while retaining a high string scale and stabilizing all moduli, by first constructing perturbative W=0 Minkowski vacua and then introducing small non-perturbative effects?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can a non-geometric flux sector generate the small constants needed by an ISS supersymmetry-breaking sector while stabilizing its gauge-coupling modulus perturbatively?

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in (string) model building: Gauge fluxes and loops

evidence.text: Can gauge-flux D-terms, a Scherk-Schwarz source for a constant superpotential, and gaugino condensation consistently stabilize the dilaton and volume moduli, and do flux-induced quantum corrections preserve the resulting minimum?

sources.title: Stabilizing moduli with thermal matter and nonperturbative effects

evidence.text: Can gaugino-condensation stabilization of the dilaton coexist with radion stabilization by enhanced-symmetry momentum/winding strings, without their combined dynamics destabilizing either modulus? The paper presents a preliminary answer under simplifying approximations.

sources.title: F-term Uplift in Heterotic M-theory

evidence.text: Can vector bundle moduli provide sufficient F-term uplift to stabilize supersymmetry-breaking Minkowski or de Sitter vacua in heterotic M-theory, including when the tree-level superpotential is constant?

sources.title: Stable Non-Supersymmetric Throats in String Theory

evidence.text: Can explicitly non-supersymmetric warped throats support a large hierarchy without UV-generated relevant perturbations prematurely ending the throat, including after compactification and coupling to four-dimensional gravity?

sources.title: Classical and Quantum SUSY Breaking Effects in IIB Local Models

evidence.text: How do classical soft terms, flavor violation, Weyl-anomaly contributions and gaugino mediation constrain supersymmetry breaking in local type IIB Large Volume Scenario models?

sources.title: A sufficient condition for de Sitter vacua in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: Can Kähler uplifting yield an analytic sufficient condition, expressed through flux and compactification data, for metastable de Sitter vacua with small positive vacuum energy, spontaneously broken supersymmetry and stabilized moduli?

sources.title: Anomalous U(1) Mediation in Large Volume Compactification

evidence.text: Does anomalous U(1)A mediation produce soft SUSY-breaking terms independent of detailed moduli mixing in LVS, and when do mixing-dependent F- and D-term contributions dominate the resulting MSSM spectrum?

sources.title: Superpotential de-sequestering in string models

evidence.text: When do geometrically distant moduli-stabilising effects or hidden scalar vevs induce visible-sector Yukawa couplings with new flavour structure, undermining sequestering and contributing to flavour violation?

sources.title: De Sitter Vacua from Nonperturbative Flux Compactifications

evidence.text: Can a moduli-dependent nonperturbative superpotential stabilize the modeled type IIB moduli simultaneously in a metastable de Sitter vacuum, without a separate explicitly supersymmetry-breaking uplift?

sources.title: On axion monodromy inflation in warped throats

evidence.text: Can flux-supported warped throats suppress the axion-inflaton scale relative to bulk moduli-stabilization physics while retaining monodromy over super-Planckian excursions, and what geometric and gauge-theory structures realize this?

sources.title: De Sitter Vacua from a D-term Generated Racetrack Uplift

evidence.text: Can a D-term relation between two small Kähler moduli generate an F-term racetrack uplift from an LVS AdS minimum to metastable de Sitter, while keeping the D-term potential zero and avoiding additional warping or dilaton suppression?

sources.title: Sequestered de Sitter String Scenarios: Soft-terms

evidence.text: How do the de Sitter mechanism and subleading matter Kähler metric determine soft supersymmetry-breaking terms in sequestered LVS compactifications, including split and approximately common-scale MSSM spectra?

sources.title: Single-step de Sitter vacua from nonperturbative effects with matter

evidence.text: Can coupled closed-string moduli and matter fields produce single-step metastable de Sitter stabilization through a pure F-term potential, without assuming that the axiodilaton and complex structure were already stabilized at a higher scale?

sources.title: De Sitter from T-branes

evidence.text: Can hidden-sector F-term uplifting induced by D-term stabilization be understood by expanding a higher-dimensional D7 theory around a supersymmetric T-brane background, and can the resulting contribution support de Sitter LVS minima?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua from an anomalous gauge symmetry

evidence.text: Can magnetic-flux and anomaly-induced FI terms, a moduli-dependent gauge kinetic function and a gauge-invariant nonperturbative superpotential stabilize moduli in metastable de Sitter or Minkowski vacua without additional low-energy uplift fields?

sources.title: A New Class of de Sitter Vacua in Type IIB Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: Can the Large Volume Scenario support perturbatively metastable de Sitter vacua through small flux-induced supersymmetry breaking in the complex-structure/axio-dilaton sector, without an additional uplift sector?

sources.title: Perturbative moduli stabilisation in type IIB/F-theory framework

evidence.text: Can logarithmic perturbative corrections to the Kähler potential, combined with magnetic D7-brane D-terms, stabilize geometric Kähler moduli at a de Sitter vacuum without nonperturbative superpotential effects?

sources.title: Uplifting Runaways

evidence.text: A warped throat must retain its conifold deformation while supplying a small uplift. In a compact embedding, fluxes and the ultraviolet gluing surface make deformation changes physical, rather than removable solely by rescaling noncompact coordinates.

sources.title: Swampland Variations on a Theme by KKLT

evidence.text: Can flux stabilization near a conifold produce a warped compactification whose conifold and Kähler moduli admit a consistent four-dimensional effective description?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua in the string landscape

evidence.text: How should anomaly-canceling form interactions be interpreted when the warped metric and flux background vary in time?

sources.title: Uplifting Anti-D6-brane

evidence.text: Can a type IIA STU effective model stabilize all moduli in a supersymmetric AdS minimum using only six-form flux and nonperturbative terms, then admit a metastable de Sitter uplift from anti-D6-branes?

sources.title: Warping and supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Separate the UV boundary and localized interior terms by integration by parts. Compare complex structures at fixed flux labels, axio-dilaton, Kähler zero mode and geometric Λ0, allowing the nonconstant warp profile and tΛ to vary. Any fixed leading bulk normalization is a separate approximation.

sources.title: SUSY Breaking at the Tip of Throat and Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: Stabilize heavy fields, estimate their auxiliary components, eliminate fluctuations and insert their vacuum values into light couplings. Here S, U, X and Z are removed while the Goldstino, T and C remain.

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Integrate the known throat contribution to a gluing cutoff, then parameterize inaccessible bulk geometry. This gives leading-volume relations; interpreting a fluxed D7 gauge coupling additionally requires checking its magnetic contribution.

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Combine a world-volume-flux D-term with non-perturbative stabilization, then minimize over charged open fields. A viable uplift requires a surviving positive contribution at the small vacuum-energy scale rather than automatic D-flatness or a Planck-scale energy.

sources.title: Moduli stabilization in (string) model building: Gauge fluxes and loops

evidence.text: Covariant-derivative commutators are mapped to harmonic-oscillator algebra to obtain charged spectra; the index theorem supplies the flux-dependent degeneracy. A four-dimensional one-loop effective-potential calculation then gives the Casimir energy.

sources.title: Stabilizing moduli with thermal matter and nonperturbative effects

evidence.text: Construct the four-dimensional N=1 supergravity potential using K(S)=−ln(S+S̄), K(T)=−3ln(T+T̄) and W=MP³(C−A exp(−a0 S)). Use its no-scale structure, expand near a dilaton minimum, and lift the approximate potential to ten-dimensional Einstein variables.

sources.title: Gaugino condensation and nonperturbative superpotentials in flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can flux stabilize coincident D7 branes at enhanced gauge symmetry while lifting their matter, thereby generating a gaugino-condensation superpotential for Kähler moduli? How does this affect arithmetic-genus restrictions and proposals with a single Kähler modulus?

sources.title: An M theory Solution to the Hierarchy Problem

evidence.text: Can strong hidden-sector gauge dynamics in fluxless G₂ compactifications stabilize moduli while generating the electroweak–Planck hierarchy, and what supersymmetry-breaking soft spectrum follows?
